entry.content:
Tammy-ann has been my pilates instructor for over 10 years. I have osteoarthritis and scoliosis. Tammy-ann adapts and fine tunes every movement to my needs. I have absolute confidence in her instruction and always enjoy our sessions.

She is acomplished in many different types of pilates and is always keen to try new ideas to make our sessions more interesting.

Kitty, Walgrave 

I had the pleasure of doing Pilates with Tammy-ann for two years, and I can't recommend her highly enough. She is exceptionally professional and knowledgeable, always tailoring sessions to what my body needed, especially during my pregnancy and my postpartum recovery. I saw noticeable improvements in my strength, posture, and overall well-being, thanks to her instruction. Furthermore my long-standing back issue eased dramatically with her help. Tammy-ann is kind, supportive and encouraging. She has a wonderful mentoring approach that's inspired me to make positive, healthy changes, both physically and in my daily habits.

Steph, Ravensthorpe
